📜 Models & Licenses

Whose weights Sophia runs

Sophia runs models on your device. The weights are downloaded directly from Hugging Face by your browser and cached locally — Sophia doesn't host or redistribute them. Each model carries its own license, listed below. If you fork or build on Sophia, these are the terms you inherit.

This list is informational, not a legal notice. Most obligations in these licenses trigger on distribution, which Hugging Face is doing rather than Sophia. Two carry conditions worth knowing: LFM Open License v1.0 is Apache-2.0-based and permits commercial use below $10M annual revenue, with nonprofits exempt from that threshold. The Gemma Terms of Use carry pass-through requirements for anyone making Gemma available to others — Sophia causes your browser to fetch Google's hosted weights, and the linked terms are the ones to read. Note that the Gemma 4 ONNX mirrors label their own metadata apache-2.0 while linking Google's Gemma terms; the terms linked here are the ones the repository itself points to.
